verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the Nix store deduplicates dependencies by content-addressed path, never overwriting but adding new versions, allowing multiple versions/variants coexisting once on disk and reused across profiles/projects (nix-docs-5, nix-docs-49, nix-docs-50, nix-docs-54, nix-docs-36). Independent hands-on testimony corroborates real-world sharing across a whole dev team and CI ('Everything is only built once... shared among all of our devs, CI, and deployment infrastructure', nix-comm-9) and cross-project dependency isolation (nix-comm-6). Missing for 10: no explicit first-party diagram/benchmark quantifying disk-space savings across many projects simultaneously.
